items.question: What specific power is ascribed to the seven-crore sovereign goddess?
premises: The goddess is identified as the seven-crore sovereign.
She is described as causing sovereignty over speech.
This characterization is presented as an established view.
items.inference: The seven-crore sovereign goddess is held to confer mastery over speech.
items.plain_english: The seven-crore sovereign goddess is considered the one who grants mastery over speech.
